craft_notes: Sthāyin: digesting-play (dawn-shine-chewing as one act). Rows: row 1 (play whole — never split the triple compound). Close: praise. Rejected: 'creation and destruction' gloss — killed: dawning/shining/chewing kept (the three verbs, unmoralized); 'meditates' for works — killed: works kept (karoti as doing).

lines: Dawn-shine and chewing-play of the world she works always —
l4.sanskrit_cite: udayāvabhāsacarvaṇalīlāṃ viśvasya yā karotyaniśam | ānandabhairavīṃ tāṃ vimarśarūpāmahaṃ vande

reads_against.argmap: Who is beside him? → Ānanda-Bhairavī as vimarśa (awareness-energy, svātantrya-śakti), non-different from Śiva as heat from fire; aggregate of awareness.
c1_essence: Bhairavī's ceaseless world-play of dawning and digesting: reflection-formed, ever praised.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta with bhakti (wonder held in devotion)
